description_html:
<section aria-labelledby="courseDescription">
    Designed for students in occupational and technical programs, this course includes measurement, operations with polynomial expressions, use of equations and formulas, basic trigonometry, and basic statistics, with emphasis on industrial and other practical applications.  A scientific calculator is required with TI 83 or TI 84 recommended.

Lecture: 3 hours.
    
</section>
